what_this_is: The limits and words of the person's sidebar for their AIs (src/sidebar.mjs): the most notes a sidebar keeps, the longest message, the biggest count shown, how many screens one note offers, how many list changes one call makes, and the notification kind a note's message rings (records/tell-the-person.json). `places` are the regions of the sidebar a row can be kept in instead of a list (src/workspace AppSidebar `sidebar_place`); a row's colour is one of the shared palette's hues, the ones a space can take (src/space-settings.json colours).
